answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a small, non-transferable stake — a copper-level deposit locked in a shared kernel of reputation. Honest work earns trust over time, while cheap duplicate accounts stay thin and cannot buy history. To keep it human-friendly, the system adds a velvet layer: gradual privileges, transparent scoring, and appeal paths, so real newcomers can still grow without opening the door to mass fake identities.
